_what_this_is: Every figure this benchmark has WITHDRAWN, in every spelling it could have been written in. It is the needle set the retraction check hunts, and it is machine-read, so it is JSON rather than prose.
_the_two_here_are_REFUTED_rather_than_st: RESULTS-2026-07-31-SUPERSEDED.md says it in its own header: the first run's two headline ratios are REFUTED, not merely out of date. They were single runs of each arm; the re-measurement on 2026-09-19 used three replicates of each, and both original ratios sit ABOVE every replicate on both clocks. A figure that a later reading placed outside its whole range is withdrawn, whatever document it lives in.
_why_the_superseded_document_is_not_excl: It is scanned like every other file. Its own header adjudicates it -- the word REFUTED is in its first paragraph and the word superseded is in its title -- and that adjudication is what the check reads. No file is excluded by name here; a document that got immunity from its name would be the one place a live claim could hide.

retracted.why: The first run's server-side `took` p95 ratio, from a single run of each arm. The three-replicate re-measurement puts every replicate below it, so it is not a noisy reading of the same quantity -- it is refuted. The current figure is in results/RESULTS.md and the per-replicate rows are in RUN-RECORD.md.
